sources.d1DatabaseApi: Cloudflare D1 prepared statements and batch/transaction semantics, modeled locally with SQLite

rows.notes: The beta access gate remains a single normalized-email lookup with caller-email equality enforced by the service.
Admin queue reads use the status/created-at index and keep direct table enumeration unavailable to non-admins.
Create retries are naturally bounded by the normalized-email unique index.
Admin status updates target a single row by primary key after the app-layer role guard.

d1RewriteStrategy.typeStrategy: Model closed-beta allowlist rows as a D1 table with normalized-email uniqueness, status CHECK constraints, app-layer platform-admin guards derived from Better Auth identity, and repository-only access for the sensitive queue.
preparedStatementPatterns: SELECT status FROM closed_beta_allowed_emails WHERE normalized_email = ? LIMIT 1
SELECT ... FROM closed_beta_allowed_emails WHERE status = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
INSERT INTO closed_beta_allowed_emails (...) SELECT ... FROM users WHERE actor.role IN ('admin', 'ceo') ON CONFLICT(normalized_email) DO NOTHING
UPDATE closed_beta_allowed_emails SET status = ?, notes = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE role IN ('admin', 'ceo'))
INSERT INTO closed_beta_allowlist_audit_events (...) ON CONFLICT(allowlist_entry_id, event_type, actor_user_id, metadata_json) DO NOTHING
